evidence.description: String search for FAT volume patterns in APP.bin: Found only '0:/' and '3:/' prefixes. No '1:/', '2:/', '4:/' or special prefixes like 'config:', 'cal:', 'data:' exist. Total: 13 unique '0:/' strings, 15 unique '3:/' strings.

Volume 0:/ usage: All 13 references point to fonts (simhei.ttf, SYMBOL.TTF, arial.ttf, etc.) and resources (ZK-INKJET-RES-HW.zkml, GT32L24M0140.spiflash). Example addresses: 0x0025cbc4, 0x0025d130, 0x002655b4.

Volume 3:/ usage: All 15 references point to firmware update files (ZK-INKJET-NANO-BOOT.bin, ZK-INKJET-NANO-APP.bin, ZK-INKJET-UI-QVGA.bin) and OBDS test resources. Example addresses: 0x002688fc, 0x0026891c, 0x0026cad8.

Settings/calibration functions (0x262778, 0x2661e0, 0x265ea8) do not reference ANY FAT volume strings. All operations use RAW SD offsets (0x28000000, 0x28800000) via sd_raw_write_aligned. Cross-reference: Finding-0009.

NVTFAT BSP library (FA93VA93 Non-OS Library Reference Guide, p.87) uses 'A'-'Z' drive letters via fsAssignDriveNumber(). Example: fsAssignDriveNumber('C', DISK_TYPE_SD_MMC, 0, 1). OBSERVATION: Firmware uses different syntax ('0:/' vs 'C'). Unknown if firmware uses NVTFAT library or different implementation.

provenance: Codex binary analysis (2026-01-14) + NVTFAT BSP documentation
summary: Firmware uses exactly two FAT volume mount points: 0:/ (fonts/resources) and 3:/ (update staging). No 1:/ or 2:/ references exist. NVTFAT BSP library uses 'A'-'Z' drive letters. How firmware maps its '0:/' and '3:/' syntax to NVTFAT is unknown - could be custom wrapper, direct mapping, or different FAT library entirely.
title: FAT Volume Mount Points: Only 0:/ and 3:/ exist in firmware
